# Choose Your Therapist

> Choose Your Therapist (CYT) is an Indian mental-health platform for finding and booking verified psychologists and therapists — online (video or audio) from anywhere in India, or in person at its centre in Sector 51, Noida. 50+ verified counselling and clinical psychologists; sessions from about ₹500; Hindi, English and other Indian languages.

## About
- [About Choose Your Therapist](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/about-us): founded in 2020 by Deepak Kumar (Founder & Director); Shubham Kumar is Associate Psychologist & Head of Operations.
- Registered health facility on the Health Facility Registry (HFR) under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), National Health Authority, Government of India — HFR ID IN0510005384.
- Operates as Choose Your Therapist LLP, registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (AAX 8113); MSME registered.
- Every psychologist's qualifications and documents are checked by the CYT team before their profile goes live. Ratings shown on profiles come from client reviews.

## How booking works
- Browse or filter psychologists by concern, language, experience, session mode (online / in-person), gender and fee; each profile shows fees and the next available day before booking.
- Not sure who to choose: the "Help me choose" helper asks three questions (concern, mode, language), or the team can call / WhatsApp back to suggest a fit.
- Pay online (UPI, card, netbanking); sessions are typically 50–60 minutes. Sessions are private and confidential.
- In a mental-health crisis in India, call Tele-MANAS on 1800-89-14416 (free, 24×7) or go to the nearest hospital.

## Find a psychologist
- [Therapist directory](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/view-all-therapist): all verified psychologists with filters, fees, languages and next available day
- [Psychologists by city and state](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/psychologist-in): hub with live counts for every city / state page

## Noida centre — book an appointment
- [Book a psychologist in Noida](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/noida-appointment): live open slots, individual and couple sessions, in-person at the Sector 51 centre, online, or as a home visit. Pay securely (UPI, card, netbanking); confirmation is instant. Sessions are 50–60 minutes. Fees are listed on the page and kept current.
- Address: Choose Your Therapist LLP, Gate No-3, D-137, near LPS Global School, Block D, Sector 51, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- Hours: Monday – Sunday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 80777 57951
- Existing clients can book a follow-up or reschedule from the same page.
- [Psychologist in Noida & Delhi](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/psychologist-in-noida-delhi): overview of therapy in Noida and Delhi NCR

## Free tools
- [Wellness toolkit](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/wellness-toolkit): guided breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, a 30-second panic SOS, mood check-in, gratitude jar, calming sounds; entries stay on the visitor's device
- [Self-assessment](https://www.chooseyourtherapist.in/self-assessment)
